about_short_description.short_description: OSN+ is a media firm that displays world-class content on its video streaming platform for users.

product.name: OSN+ Streaming Service
product.description: A subscription-based video streaming platform offering a library of movies and TV series from international, Arabic, and Turkish producers for users in the MENA region.

product.name: OSN+ Mobile and TV Applications
product.description: Applications for iOS, Android, and smart TVs that enable users to access OSN+ content on multiple devices with account management and streaming capabilities.

product.name: Subscription and Payment Management
product.description: A system enabling users to subscribe to OSN+ via multiple payment methods and manage their subscription plans and billing cycles.

product.name: Content Delivery and Streaming Technology
product.description: A streaming infrastructure that delivers encrypted video content in real-time to authorized devices for immediate playback without permanent storage.

product.name: Customer Support and Help Center
product.description: Support services including online chat, email, and social media channels to assist users with account, subscription, and technical issues.
